parent_objective: design no-training rollout candidate generation after env-hook reset viability
blocked_by: env-hook specs reset successfully, but measured rollout candidate generation is not yet designed
supersedes: direct corpus export or training after reset-only runtime smoke

public_gates: M1507 must design no-training rollout candidate generation for T4/T5 hooks
M1507 must define source history collection, matching distances, terminal-margin measurement, and intervention variants
M1507 must preserve public/private holdout separation and actor-input contract
M1507 must block training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, and corpus export
M1507 must route to implementation or record a simulator-scope blocker
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim self-identification from reset-only evidence
do not materialize candidates without measured rollout margins and interventions

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs how reset-viable hook specs become measured T4/T5 rollout candidates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if rollout design cannot measure current/recent/older-history distances
stop if intervention variants would leak labels into actor input
stop if design cannot separate reset-only plumbing from candidate evidence
stop if candidate selection would tune on private holdout
fallback_plan: if full T4/T5 rollout design is too broad, design one T4 and one T5 rollout probe first
if current sim cannot produce non-AEB labels under public hooks, add a public source-family retarget design
if intervention measurement needs policy tooling, route to bounded public policy-runner design before rollout
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1506 reset-only env-hook runtime smoke passed

admission_evidence: M1506 reset-only runtime smoke passed all six source families with zero guardrail violations
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation or blocker manifest
next_stage_criteria: next implementation or blocker is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1507 must design controls that prevent current-frame-only substitution from being misread as history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: wrong-history delayed reset and current-tiled interventions
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: design only; no new temporal evidence generated.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If rollout design cannot support decisive T4/T5 evidence, record simulator-scope or intervention-scope blocker before training.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1506 reset-viable hook specs can be extended into a no-training rollout candidate-generation design that measures T4/T5 history necessity without actor-input leakage.
success_criteria: design names source history collection, matching metrics, terminal-margin measurement, and interventions
design defines when candidates may be materialized
design blocks training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, and corpus export
design routes to implementation or records a blocker
failure_criteria: design leaves rollout candidate materialization ambiguous
design relies on reset-only evidence as self-ID evidence
design starts training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or corpus export
decision_rule: M1507 passes if it designs measured rollout candidate generation before implementation, corpus export, or training.
